title.en: How fast a rule may change

statement.en: A rule that never reads the fast level is unreached and loses what it merges; a fast difference reaches a rule only at a reading step. Given two values, a stretch of L steps fixes every pair of held courses with at most N states exactly when L ≥ 2N − 1.
statement.zh: 从不读快层的规则不被触及，并失去它所合并者；快层的差别只在读取之步触及规则。给定两个值，L 步的段落确定每对至多 N 个状态的持守进程，恰当 L ≥ 2N − 1。

laws.en: A two-level course, the fast configuration stepping by a rule that changes only at reading steps, is a run of one law; a rule that never reads is kept, nothing the fast level meets reaches it, and under it what is lost stays lost and merges lose configurations.
laws.zh: 两层进程（快构形依规则步进，规则只在读取之步改变）是一条律的运行；从不读取的规则保持不变，快层所遇的都触及不到它，在它之下失去的保持失去，合并失去构形。

laws.en: A fast difference reaches the rule only at a reading step: up to and including the first reading step the rule is the one at the start, exact in Copying; regaining what a fixed rule loses needs a change of rule (Switching).
laws.zh: 快层的差别只在读取之步触及规则：直到并包括第一个读取之步，规则都是开始时的那个，在 Copying 中精确；恢复固定规则所失去的需要改变规则（Switching）。

laws.en: Given two values, a stretch of L steps fixes every pair of courses with at most N states that held rules generate exactly when L ≥ 2N − 1: shorter stretches dissolve (from prefix_short_twice), longer ones fix (from bounded_agree); within a paced course a rule held that long is fixed over its stretch.
laws.zh: 给定两个值，L 步的段落确定由持守规则生成的每对至多 N 个状态的进程，恰当 L ≥ 2N − 1：更短的段落消散（由 prefix_short_twice），更长的确定（由 bounded_agree）；在分层进程中持守这么久的规则在其段落上被确定。

laws.en: A course of configurations read whole, with at most N states, is fixed among every run of every law by its first N + 1 steps, exactly.
laws.zh: 整体读取、至多 N 个状态的构形进程，在每条律的每次运行之间由其前 N + 1 步确定，且恰好如此。

hypotheses.en: No axiom; the fast law, the reading law and the reading steps are given; courses with at most N states are read through a map; the pace law quantifies over fast levels in Type, the fixing side in every universe.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理；快律、读取律与读取之步是给定的；至多 N 个状态的进程经一个映射读取；步调律对 Type 中的快层量化，确定的一侧在每个宇宙中成立。

does_not_show.en: Which rule a slow level reads into, that it reads at stretches of any length, or how many states an actual fast level has.
does_not_show.zh: 慢层读入哪条规则，它以任何长度的段落读取，或实际快层有多少状态。

does_not_show.en: That a layered pace is better than another; many levels and rules that change by chance.
does_not_show.zh: 一种分层步调优于另一种；多层与随机改变的规则。

next_delta.en: Many levels; noisy rules; which reading law adapts; an independent review.
next_delta.zh: 多层；有噪声的规则；哪条读取律能适应；独立审查。

correspondence.en: An account of social viability Ren brought on 19 October 2026 lists eight constraints and a unifying ninth; the AI's mapping found this one (stability with adaptability) partial, with no law of the pace of a rule. Ren's words are provenance, not warrant; the reading onto collectives is the AI's (D48).
correspondence.zh: Ren 于 2026年10月19日带来的一段社会可存续性文字列出八条约束与统一它们的第九条；AI 的对照发现此条（稳定与适应）部分承载，没有关于规则步调的定律。Ren 的话是出处，不是依据；读到集体上是 AI 的（D48）。
